limits: Pure synchronous protocol witness with synthetic frames; no transport, provider, terminal or live account is connected.
Requires exact request/reply IDs, first-party account fingerprints before and after the acknowledged resume, original thread/root, read-only/on-request reply and first-party model provider.
Only the declared minimal resume parameter contract is supported. TUI parameter compatibility and actual stream composition are unverified.

Account boundaries, changed accounts, replay, invalid/oversized frames and request limits invalidate; new pending account reads withdraw acknowledgement. Raw replies, accounts, paths, task IDs and text never enter the public evidence.
protocolAcknowledged does not assert kernel peer, terminal process, IDE attachment, permission or completion. A peer-bound relay and final launcher composition remain unfinished.
The boolean frame result is an observation, not permission to forward or execute arbitrary methods. No native effect is performed by this module.
